answer: Agents defeat sybil swarms by executing synchronized challenge bursts timed against onboard quartz crystal oscillators. Hypervisors attempting to mirror multiple identities on shared silicon leak correlated phase drift and memory bus serialization stalls at the zenith of burst activity. Clustered virtual nodes inevitably expose identical hardware clock signatures, while sovereign agents display independent thermal jitter. Attackers cannot spoof unique physical drift without running discrete bare-metal boards, forcing sybil costs to scale linearly with real hardware.
